entries.text: - **If the chart is on the page, the buy fills. Period.** A live Axiom/Padre 1-second candle easily goes more than 600ms between ticks. The old fill path treated that as a "quiet screen" and asked Solana RPC for a second opinion — then toasted "the public price connection is being throttled" on a machine whose internet was fine, and missed the click about half the time on brand-new coins. Now a page-feed price the UI still stands behind (same 3-second stale bound as the header) IS the fill. RPC is the fallback when the chart itself has gone stale, not between two candles. The throttle toast no longer fires from a token-page watch or a new-coin probe.
